biotools.summary: The Sudden Cardiac Death Holter Database (SDDB) is a resource providing long-term Holter ECG signals used for predicting life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias. It is designed for deep learning analysis incorporating Graph Neural Networks and Transformers.
